findings.finding: Existing tests cover Staff search/selection, queue and Inbox flows, account-audit authorization, and the R11 retained-history/audit view. The newly accepted bounded-read contract still needs explicit assertions for 25-row paging and independently authorized detail outside the visible page; this finding concerns those new boundaries only.
findings.evidence: tests/e2e/account-assisted/actor-authority.spec.ts L626-L747; tests/e2e/account-decisions/staff-ui.spec.ts L15-L135, L139-L258; tests/e2e/r11-ui.spec.ts L643-L805. These assert current roster/search, audit access/history presentation, and Inbox behavior; the reviewed flows do not assert the new page-size/navigation or outside-page detail contract.
findings.action: Add the accepted 25-row navigation and outside-page detail checks to the existing Staff, audit, queue and Inbox owners as applicable; preserve current authority, private-note and retained-history behavior.
